questions.q: According to Section 601, what is the official definition of 'Fire-resistive rating'?
o: The length of time a material can withstand being burned
The cost of fireproofing a material per square meter
The maximum temperature a wall can reach before collapsing
The degree to which a material can withstand fire determined by accepted testing methods
questions.n: Section 601 defines the rating as the degree of resistance based on recognized testing standards.

questions.q: Based on the provided table, what is the required overall depth (in mm) for a solid R.C. slab to achieve a 2-hour fire resistance?
questions.n: The table specifies that a 2-hour rating for solid R.C. slab floor construction requires an overall depth of 125 mm.

questions.q: Which Section of Rule VI specifies that the Secretary shall prescribe standards for testing construction materials?
questions.n: Section 604, 'Fire-Resistive Regulations,' gives the Secretary the power to prescribe standards and promulgate rules.
